viewing_check: Smell and cut a tiny edge or look at end grain: Huon pine has a strong sweet oil smell and very fine even rings. Check length, width and thickness, and whether the face is cracked, checked or has pronounced bird's-eye or figure. Width over about 40 cm and length over 2 m with clean grain is the top of the range.
